name: recall_output
description: Read back a packed tool output by its id, one page at a time. A packed output names its id; pass it with a character offset (0 for the first page), or search for a case-sensitive literal string at or after that offset.

id.description: The packed output id from its placeholder

offset.description: Characters to skip; 0 reads from the start

search.description: Case-sensitive literal text to find at or after offset; the page starts at the first match
